summary: Single-family house: written repair shift is allowed; fee waiver and 90-day notice are not.

findings.quote: Tenant must give Owner written notice at least 90 days before the end of the term if Tenant will not renew.
Each party shall bear its own attorney fees and costs in any dispute arising out of this Agreement.

outOfScope.quote: Tenant shall follow the HOA's parking and trash rules

nearMisses.quote: Tenant is responsible for routine repairs to the plumbing
nearMisses.note: allowed in writing for a single-family home (83.51(1))
